description: This file defines types, structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling radio event handlers in a wireless LAN context. It includes typedefs for callback functions, handler structures, and initialization macros, as well as functions to handle events by name or index.

methods.name: wld_radEvtHandler_handleEventByName
methods.description: Handles a radio event by matching the event name with registered handlers.

methods.name: wld_radEvtHandler_handleEventByIndex
methods.description: Handles a radio event by index, using the handler array.
